caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical urn with a lid, rendered in shades of brown and accented with thin, yellowish lines that outline its segments. The urn is tall and vertically elongated, with a rounded body that gradually tapers to a small pedestal base, which sits on a square plinth. The lid is dome-shaped with a finial at the top and fits seamlessly with the main body of the urn. The overall composition centers the urn against a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects or patterns, creating a clear focus on the urn itself. The only text in the image is small and located at the bottom right corner, showing the names “A. McQuillan” and “J. Birckhead.”
title: Knife and Spoon Box
